unresolved_risks: The pink/chroma trail is not demonstrated fixed; current image-quality candidate is rejected.
Original sample independence, rare-tail truth and converged same-pose radiance are unavailable.
Current-frame spatial Neff is not calibrated confidence under correlated Monte Carlo/RR estimates.
No pre-window history reconstruction, outside-crop samples or actual final remodulated output exists in the supplied clips.
Frozen synthetic finite-image mask and crop-limited B4/soft2 controls have the explicitly reported support limitations.
Log and additive-linear clamps give different achieved correction; no equal-strength representation superiority is claimed.
Protected words and all alpha are exact; pre-store luma closure is not exact FP16 stored luma or final-composite preservation.
FP16 RTZ has an absolute quantization envelope; relative error is appreciable near subnormal values.
Multiplicative correction cannot create a genuinely zero raw RGB channel.
HLSL is uncompiled; CPU/shader/native parity, descriptor ordering, debug/lifetime safety and actual ON routing require local validation.
Conservative packed staging has substantial analytic memory/copy cost; no measured GPU timing or residency is available.
recommendation_reason: Preservation contracts pass, but temporal grain and subtle-boundary contamination remain and correction is weaker than B4. Keep reproducible diagnostics and the negative result; do not deploy this frozen candidate as a fix.
